ops.body: Fixed by the cut (0efa6e8): ClientConfig.Authorize is required (internal/wire/client.go:288-289) and invoked between dial and hello (:100-108, :232) — no byte, hello included, reaches an unverified peer. 205ba99's own body records the measurement: a real squatter reads 0 bytes. The Swift half's equivalent gap stays tracked in 205ba99.
